description: This file defines extension methods for the IClientBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace, allowing configuration of grain call filters (incoming and outgoing) via various methods including direct filter instances, implementation types, and delegates.

classes.name: ClientBuilderGrainCallFilterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IClientBuilder to add grain call filters.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter to the builder's filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter implementation by type to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter via a delegate to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter to the builder's filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter implementation by type to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter via a delegate to the filter pipeline.
